content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am writing to review the agreement and request a couple of adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on consulting services, the agreement lacks a change-order mechanism, meaning additional services can be requested without guaranteed extra compensation; I propose that any material changes or additions to the services specified on Schedule A shall be agreed upon in a written change order detailing any adjustments to fees and timelines. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, intellectual property rights are assigned to the client immediately upon creation rather than being conditioned upon full payment; I propose that upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, the Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in and to the deliverables created under this Agreement. Thank you for your time, and please let me know if these updates work for you.
